license.value: Apache-2.0 (card YAML license: apache-2.0; HF tag license:apache-2.0). No use restrictions beyond Apache-2.0; not gated. Training data repos IFM/K2-Horizon-Pretrain-Data and Midtrain-Data listed.

params.value: Total 37,444,792,020 (HF safetensors BF16). Active: vendor says 4B; vLLM v0.33.0 recipe says '5.95B active parameters per token' including embeddings. Arithmetic from config: routed FFN experts 8/100 x 26.54B = 2.12B, value experts 4/64 x 7.55B = 0.47B, attention 1.64B, shared experts 0.27B, dense MLP layers 0-2 0.14B = about 4.65B non-embedding; plus lm_head 0.64B and embedding 0.64B = 5.93B, matching the recipe.

architecture.value: K2HorizonForCausalLM (model_type k2_horizon, custom_code). 48 layers, hidden 2560, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, full attention on all 48 layers (sliding_window null, use_sliding_window false; llama.cpp graph uses build_attn_inp_kv, no SWA), softplus output gate on attention, partial-RoPE fields (rope_head_dim 128 = head_dim), rope_theta 1e7. MoE in layers 3-47 (mlp_only_layers [0,1,2]): 100 routed experts top-8, moe_intermediate 768, 1 shared expert (768), sigmoid router, scaling 2.5. MoVA: in layers 3-47 v_proj is replaced by 64 value experts top-4 (each 2560 -> 1024), so the value projection is itself a routed MoE. vocab 250,624, untied lm_head. Q4_K_M GGUF tensor split: ffn_*_exps 14.90 GiB, attn_v_exps 3.96 GiB, rest 1.96 GiB.

context_length.value: max_position_embeddings 524,288 (card: 'Native 524,288-token context from the midtraining stages onward'). On this machine: llama.cpp 64k with q8_0 KV (about 80k max with all experts in RAM); vLLM does not fit.

modalities.value: Text in, text out only. pipeline_tag text-generation; chat template raises on any non-text content part ('extract file contents to text before templating'); Ollama tags show 'Text input'. MoVA = Mixture-of-Values attention, not vision, so there is no vision tower and no --language-model-only concern.

thinking.how_to_toggle: Reasoning always on, with three effort levels set by chat_template_kwargs reasoning_effort high (default, <ifm|think>), medium (<ifm|think_fast>), low (<ifm|think_faster>). The card says to always use high. vLLM v0.33.0: per request extra_body {"chat_template_kwargs":{"reasoning_effort":"low"}} or server-wide --default-chat-template-kwargs; reasoning parser k2_horizon; no off switch (HF main template has no enable_thinking). Open vLLM bug #62743: at medium/low the model closes with </ifm|think>, so reasoning leaks into content. llama.cpp b12407: --chat-template-kwargs '{"reasoning_effort":"high"}' or per request chat_template_kwargs; the dedicated parser accepts </ifm|think> at medium/low (fix #30335, 2026-11-12, in b12407). Real off only with the official IFM GGUF's embedded template, which contains 'enable_thinking is false' -> empty <ifm|think></ifm|think>; llama.cpp honours --reasoning off / enable_thinking only when the template contains enable_thinking (common/parsers/k2-horizon.cpp line 29). bartowski's GGUF embeds the newer template (identical to llama.cpp models/templates/IFM-K2-Horizon.jinja) without enable_thinking. Ollama ifm/k2-horizon: 'Reasoning can't be turned off.'

vllm.kv_math: Budget 16303 MiB x 0.92 = 14999 MiB = 14.65 GiB. KV/token = 2 x 48 full-attention layers x 8 KV heads x 128 x 2 B = 196,608 B (192 KiB) BF16, 98,304 B FP8. Pool = 14.65 - weights - 1.2: BF16 69.78 -> -56.3 GiB; FP8 45.07 -> -31.6; GPTQ 20.25 -> -6.8; AWQ 22.58 -> -9.1; NVFP4 34.22 -> -20.8. Every checkpoint leaves a negative KV pool, so max context 0 for BF16 and FP8 KV. Expert CPU offload is not a plan (#66264, Marlin repack undoes it).
vllm.quant_on_sm120: Moot (no fit). Source note: K2HorizonMoVAAttention.compute_mova_v_sparse (k2_horizon.py lines 912-935) stacks expert.weight and calls fused_mova_impl with no quant flags, so a checkpoint that quantizes v_experts (GPTQ, AWQ builds) is likely to fail or miscompute in vLLM; the IFM FP8 and primitive-ai NVFP4 builds keep v_experts in BF16 (inferred from source; a vLLM maintainer comment in #55512 says in-tree supports fp8/int8/int4 in general).

llamacpp.offload_plan: Parsed GGUF header (bartowski Q4_K_M): ffn_{up,gate,down}_exps 14.94 GiB = 0.332 GiB per MoE block (blocks 3-47); attn_v_exps 3.96 GiB; everything else 2.23 GiB. --n-cpu-moe only matches '\.ffn_(up|down|gate|gate_up)_(ch|)exps' (common.h line 1286), so attn_v_exps stays on GPU: 6.19 GiB fixed on GPU. KV q8_0 = 48 x 2 x 1024 x 1.0625 B = 104,448 B/token; 65,536 tokens = 6.375 GiB (f16 would be 12.0 GiB, does not fit). Compute buffers about 1.3 GiB (250k vocab: logits alone 0.49 GiB at ub 512). 6.19 + 6.375 + 1.3 = 13.87 GiB; about 15.8 GiB usable leaves room for 4 MoE blocks of experts (1.33 GiB): --n-cpu-moe 44 puts blocks 0-43 (41 MoE blocks, 13.6 GiB) in RAM and blocks 44-47 on GPU, total about 15.2 GiB VRAM. With --cpu-moe (all experts in RAM) VRAM left for KV is about 8.3 GiB: about 85k tokens q8_0 or 45k f16. 128k needs q4_0 KV, not recommended. Or leave -ncmoe unset and let --fit place experts.

speed_notes: Inferred upper bound, llama.cpp bartowski Q4_K_M with --n-cpu-moe 44: GPU bytes per token about 2.25 GiB (attention 1.04, lm_head 0.49, shared experts 0.23, active value experts 4/64 x 3.96 = 0.25, dense MLP and routers 0.13, 4 GPU expert blocks x 8% = 0.11) = 2.4 GB / 896 GB/s = 2.7 ms; RAM experts 41 blocks x 0.332 GiB x 8/100 = 1.09 GiB = 1.17 GB / 80-100 GB/s = 11.7-14.6 ms; KV read at 32k q8_0 3.4 GB = 3.8 ms. Bound about 58-69 tok/s near empty context, 48-55 tok/s at 32k; expect roughly half in practice (25-40 tok/s), similar to Qwen3.6-35B-A3B pick #1. Always-on high reasoning multiplies tokens per turn. Prefill with experts in RAM is limited by #25859; raise -ub to 2048 only if VRAM allows (bigger compute buffer). Third-party measurement (not this machine): an out-of-tree vLLM plugin on an L40S reported about 69 tok/s single-stream decode on GPTQ Int4 (#55512).

opencode_fit.recommended_checkpoint: bartowski/K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B-GGUF Q4_K_M (21.14 GiB); IFM official Q4_K_M (20.83 GiB) if a thinking-off option is wanted
opencode_fit.recommended_context: 65536 with q8_0 KV and --n-cpu-moe 44 (about 85k is the ceiling with all experts in RAM)
opencode_fit.caveats: Best independent agentic scores in its size class among verified picks (AA TB2.1 56.6 vs 44.9 and tau3-Banking 32.0 vs 9.3 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B), Apache-2.0, native llama.cpp support with a dedicated tool parser. But: KV is heavy (192 KiB/token f16, 48 full-attention layers), so 64k needs q8_0 KV and 128k is out of reach, where Qwen3.6 reaches 128k; reasoning is always on and the vendor wants high effort, so agent turns are slow and OpenCode can hit #55378 (reasoning-only turn) if output limits are low; temperature 1.0 recommended; llama.cpp support is about 6 weeks old with recent parser fixes; strict template rejects history without a reasoning field on vLLM and Ollama (llama.cpp patches it); vLLM cannot fit any checkpoint in 16 GB. Nothing has run on this machine: tool-call smoke test and a short OpenCode session are needed before promoting it.
